title: JavaScript Developer
description: Master modern JavaScript (ES6+), DOM manipulation, async programming, event loop, closures, prototypes, and web APIs.

nodes.title: Foundations
nodes.description: JavaScript introduction, runtime environments, basic syntax, variables, data types, and operators.

children.title: Introduction to JavaScript & V8 Engine
children.description: History of ECMAScript, JS runtimes (browser, Node.js), and JIT compilation.

children.title: Variables (var, let, const)
children.description: Block scope, function scope, hoisting, and temporal dead zone (TDZ).

children.title: Data Types & Type Coercion
children.description: Primitives (string, number, boolean, null, undefined, symbol, bigint) vs reference types.

children.title: Operators & Expressions
children.description: Arithmetic, logical, bitwise, strict equality (===), nullish coalescing (??), and optional chaining (?.).

nodes.title: Functions & Scope
nodes.description: Function declarations, expressions, arrow functions, closures, call stack, and scope chain.

children.title: Functions & Arrow Syntax
children.description: Parameters, return values, rest/spread parameters, and lexical this binding.

children.title: Closures & Scope Chain
children.description: Lexical environment, outer reference, closure memory persistence, and private data encapsulation.

children.title: Higher-Order Functions
children.description: Callbacks, Array methods (map, filter, reduce, find, every, some).

nodes.title: Async JavaScript & Event Loop
nodes.description: Asynchronous execution, Call Stack, Event Loop, Microtask queue, Promises, and async/await.

children.title: Callbacks & Callback Hell
children.description: Asynchronous callbacks, inversion of control, and error handling patterns.

children.title: Promises (Promise.all, race, settle)
children.description: Promise states (pending, fulfilled, rejected), chaining, and combinators.

children.title: Async / Await Syntax
children.description: Syntactic sugar over Promises, try-catch error handling, and sequential vs parallel async execution.

children.title: Event Loop & Microtasks
children.description: Call stack execution, Web APIs, Task queue vs Microtask queue (Promises vs setTimeout).
